arguments.message:
Hi there,

According to our policy, seats that are cancelled part‑way through a billing cycle are not automatically prorated on standard plans. The seat stops being billed starting with the next cycle rather than being refunded for the remainder of the current cycle. If you believe the charge was applied incorrectly, our billing team can review the seat history against the invoice to verify the billing.

Let us know if you’d like us to start that review.

Thanks!
